summary: UC-102 native Postgres schema: 4-table multi-tenant schema (projects + user_stories/use_cases/acceptance_criteria, all with project_id FK + version column), idempotent migration (CREATE TABLE/INDEX IF NOT EXISTS), project_id indexes per spec table. asyncpg pool (pool.py) with env-only DSN (SPECBOX_NATIVE_DSN, Frontier 2), lazy init/get/close. Idempotent migration runner (migrate.py). asyncpg>=0.30 added to deps. Verified twice-apply on populated DB with no error; ruff 0/0; mypy clean (added asyncpg import override). Not wired into server.py/auth_gateway.py (UC-101/UC-103 scope).

Added tests/test_native_schema.py: 4 pytest acceptance tests for UC-102 against real Postgres (localhost:55432). test_pool_roundtrip [AC-02], test_version_default [AC-03], test_migration_idempotent [AC-04], test_project_isolation across US/UC/AC tables [AC-05]. Module-level skip guard probes the dev DSN with a 2s timeout in a throwaway loop and skips cleanly if unreachable. Fixture opens the project pool via init_pool(dsn=), runs apply_migrations, yields (pool, created_ids), and on teardown DELETEs only test-uc102-* projects (CASCADE) + close_pool() — never drops tables. All 4 passed (ran, did not skip); ruff check + format clean.
